_comment: Everyday Finnish A1 is voiced by ElevenLabs eleven_v3 with NATIVE FINNISH voices from the library (Swedish was fixed the same way: a non-native voice misreads the language). The old cast had a French voice for Alex (said 'Moi' as 'mwa'), an American voice for Anna, an Indian-accented one for Markku. Voices (chosen by ear by Tung, 2026-10-24): alex=Davi Andrei (Brazilian, since 2026-10-25: Alex is from Brazil, so a foreign accent is right for him; his Finnish lines must still be clear), linnea=Aurora, sanni=Aava, markku=Petteri, leo=Jussi, anna=Soili (middle-aged: the library has no native elderly woman). Each line is levelled to the same loudness and single words get up to 6 retries.
